create_asr_model_auto: create an ASR model option that auto-selects MLX on Apple Silicon or falls back to native Whisper
create_asr_model_mlx: create an ASR model option that forces MLX Whisper implementation on Apple Silicon hardware
create_asr_model_native: create an ASR model option that forces native HuggingFace Whisper implementation
run_asr_model_enum: run ASR model selection using the AsrModelType enum with auto, MLX, or native variants
get_whisper_model_size: get a Whisper model option by size (tiny, small, medium, base, large, turbo) with auto hardware selection
